## Execution tips

- At a cup-rim section with more outside clearance, consider placing one finger inside and one against the outside, with pads covering a short wall section below the rim. Match the opening to local wall thickness and clearance to reduce slipping and rim collisions.
- Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on the inside and outside of the cup wall rather than merely overlapping in the image. If the view is unclear, adjust the viewing angle slightly to avoid a missed grasp or pushing the cup over.
- Keep the cup opening facing upward and the base off the table during transport. Leave clearance from the gripper to the yellow bottle behind it to avoid dragging the cup base or sweeping into nearby objects during pose adjustment.
- Near the coaster surface, lower in small vertical steps and release only after confirming the cup bottom is supported. When opening and withdrawing, avoid the rim as much as possible so as not to tip the cup or push it off the coaster.
